Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Validation

Record the checks run and their results.

- [ ] Python lint and relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Frontend syntax checks and tests pass when affected.
- [ ] No credentials, private scans, runtime databases or full source recordings are included.
- [ ] Localhost and synthetic-document boundaries remain intact, or changes are explained.
- [ ] Configuration and documentation reflect the final behavior.
